Pages show what they loaded at once, and check again in the background whenever you open one or come back to the window, so you rarely need Refresh (Activity at most once a minute). While a page stays open it re-checks on its own (PRs 2 min, runs 1 min or 15 s while running, local git 20 s, Activity 5 min). Click it or press Ctrl+R to reload everything now.
